ruleDefinitions.name: Use of VSIISExeLauncher.exe
ruleDefinitions.description: The "VSIISExeLauncher.exe" binary part of the Visual Studio/VS Code can be used to execute arbitrary binaries

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\VSIISExeLauncher\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "VSIISExeLauncher\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-p\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-a\\ .*")))
